title: An interactive toolkit for analysing metabolic dynamics through mass spectrometry imaging
text: SMEW graphical abstract Spatial metabolomics, measured mass spectrometry imaging (MSI), provides high-throughput, spatially resolved information metabolite distributions within tissues. offers direct readout cellular biochemical activity phenotype fully captured transcriptomics proteomic profiling. However, inferring biologically meaningful patterns noisy, high-dimensional MSI data, particularly across multiple samples complex experimental designs, remains challenging, often requires substantial programming expertise. introduce SMEW (Spatial Metabolomics Enhanced Workflow), flexible, interactive shareable Shiny-based platform designed enable code-free downstream analysis spatial metabolomics MSI data. SMEW provides unified environment hierarchical analysis across bulk-, region- pixel-level resolutions, allowing users compare experimental conditions like disease treatment groups, identify coherent metabolic patterns link patterns biological pathways. workflow leverages local spatial covariation robustly summarise MSI data dimensionality reduction, clustering, identification spatially variable metabolites, co-localisation covariation network analysis, spatially-resolved pathway enrichment within single interface. SMEW applicable across MSI technologies mass resolutions, illustrated case studies DESI MALDI-ToF datasets lung, liver, kidney. complementing existing MSI processing visualisation tools accessible, multi-sample, biologically interpretable analysis framework, SMEW enables functional, flexible, rigorous intuitive exploration spatial metabolomics datasets.
